+def test_map_book_uses_isbn_10_from_isbn_field():

+        'ASIN': None, 'ISBN': '123456789X',

+def test_stage_incomplete_books_prefers_isbn_and_records_gauges(monkeypatch):
+    calls = []
+    gauges = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(imports, 'get_amazon_metadata', lambda **kwargs: calls.append(kwargs))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(imports.stats, 'gauge', lambda key, value: gauges.append((key, value)))
+    books = [
+        {'title': 'A', 'authors': [{'name': 'Author'}], 'publish_date': '2000',
+         'isbn_10': ['1234567890']},
+        {'title': 'B', 'isbn_10': ['1234567890'],
+         'identifiers': {'amazon': ['B123456789']}},
+        {'title': 'C', 'identifiers': {'amazon': ['B987654321']}},
+    ]
+    imports.stage_b_asins_for_import(books)
+    assert calls == [
+        {'id_': '1234567890', 'id_type': 'isbn'},
+        {'id_': 'B987654321', 'id_type': 'asin'},
+    ]
+    assert gauges == [('promise_items.total', 3), ('promise_items.incomplete', 2)]
+
